Why Reels show on main grid
points.sentence: Instagram defaults all Reels to appear on your main feed. This is Instagram's behavior, not a Blotato setting.

verdict.reason: The customer asks staff to post for them, which is a request for staff to post something and is not mine to answer, so I pass the whole message to the team even though the Reels question has a matching entry.
